features.name: Data-driven Testing in AL
features.description: A new testing capability allowing a single test method to run with multiple data sets. Enables flexible test expansion by adding data points rather than duplicating test methods.

features.name: Test Data Source Interface
features.description: An interface for implementing custom data sources for data-driven tests. Supports reading from resource files, AL tables, or web services. Returns a strongly-typed test context.
caveats: Custom implementations can read from resource files, AL tables, or web services

features.name: Data-driven Testing in Visual Studio Code
features.description: Integration of data-driven testing with VS Code test explorer, allowing selective test case execution, debugging, and all standard test explorer features.

features.name: Data-driven Testing in AL Tooling and MCP
features.description: Support for running data-driven tests via AL tool and AL MCP connection, in addition to VS Code. AI test toolkit currently uses old capabilities and migration is planned.
caveats: AI test toolkit not yet migrated to new capabilities; cannot run from VS Code yet

features.name: Test Handlers
features.description: A mechanism for providing test setup and teardown functionality at multiple granularity levels: before/after test codeunit, before/after test procedure, and before/after individual datadriven tests.

features.name: Opt-in Test Handlers
features.description: Test handlers that must be explicitly declared by the test codeunit via the test handlers property. Allow granular control over which test handlers apply to specific test codeunits.

features.name: Default Test Handlers
features.description: Global test handlers that run on every single test automatically without requiring explicit declaration. Useful for telemetry, verifying Microsoft features, and setting up common test infrastructure.

features.name: ITestHandler Interface
features.description: Interface with hooks for before/after logic at codeunit, procedure, and test case levels. All methods have default implementations, allowing selective override.
caveats: Default implementations allow selective override of only needed methods

features.name: Test Handlers Property
features.description: A property on test codeunits allowing registration of test handlers via comma-separated list. Supports self-implementing pattern where the test codeunit itself implements ITestHandler.
caveats: Separate from test toolkit events driven by AL test runners

features.name: Test Case Skipping via Test Handlers
features.description: Ability to conditionally skip test cases using test handlers. Useful for managing resource consumption such as token usage limits and AI credits.
caveats: Requires monitoring and conditional logic implementation
